en.title: When Metro Construction Meets Archaeology in China
en.headline: A Metro Dig Can Become an Archaeological Question Before It Becomes a Delay
en.description: Follow the survey, excavation, protection and construction decisions that can occur when a China metro project encounters an older city below ground.
en.heroAlt: AI-assisted miniature editorial illustration of a generic city cutaway, survey grid and separated metro alignment; not a real excavation or project
en.featuredLinkLabel: Read the city below a metro project

zh.description: 从调查、勘探、发掘、保护到继续建设，理解中国城市轨道工程碰到地下历史遗存时可能经历的决策链。
